add_and_persist.statement: add stores a task with id, title, description, priority, status and due_date; it is readable by a later separate invocation.
must_include: task fields id, title, description, priority, status, due_date
persist in SQLite with raw sqlite3

allowed_values.statement: priority accepts only low, medium, high and status only todo, in-progress, done; defaults are medium and todo; other values exit non-zero.

update_and_delete.statement: update changes only the given fields and delete removes the task; an unknown id exits non-zero.

filter_list.statement: list --status and --priority return only matching tasks, alone and combined.

mark_done.statement: done ID sets status to done and leaves other fields unchanged.

table_output.statement: list prints a header row and one aligned row per task with the columns ID, Title, Priority, Status, Due.

invalid_input.statement: invalid due_date, empty title or unknown id exit non-zero with a message on stderr.
must_include: task fields id, title, description, priority, status, due_date

single_file_stdlib.statement: task_manager.py imports only stdlib modules and is the single entry point, with no ORM.
